prediction.likelyOutcome: Expect the landlords to prevail on the Tres Botes claim largely as pleaded (admissions establish breach; the sale-of-premises defense misreads a standard assignment clause), but to face a genuine fight — and a real risk of losing outright — on the Dos Botes claim given the disputed lease renewal and the unresolved question of whether SDP even remained the landlord of record after its 2013 conveyance to KSN Hospitality. Net recovery is likely to land well below the combined $513,200 requested, driven down primarily by the Dos Botes uncertainties rather than by the Tres Botes claim, which should hold up close to its full value.

outcome.description: Trial court (judgment signed September 22, 2025) granted summary judgment awarding SMK $79,096.44 against Tres Botes (18 months plus one prorated month at $4,300 until the property was sold) and SDP $108,000 against Dos Botes (12 months at $9,000 until relet), $187,096.44 total; no attorney's fees mentioned. On appeal the $79,096.44 award to SMK was affirmed; the $108,000 award to SDP was reversed and remanded because SDP did not conclusively prove the lease was renewed.
outcome.finalNote: $79,096.44 affirmed; the $108,000 Dos Botes award reversed and remanded, so the final total could rise.
